parts.text: litte 和 few 在口语中多用 not much，not many 代替： 在 what 引导的感叹句中不用 much / many：
在日常谈话中，通常避免在肯定句中使用much 和 many，而用别的数量词。口语中用得最多的表示“许多”的数量词是 a lot of，它既可以与复数可数名词连用也可以与不可数名词连用，后面的动词用单数还是复数取决于名词。比 a lot of 正式一些的表达方式有：
a great/good deal of + 不可数名词
a great/good/large number of + 复数名词
a great/good many of + 复数名词。

rows: much
许多，大量
修饰或指代不可数名词
There isn't much I can do to help him.（指代）
a great deal (of...)
there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
a lot (of...)
That's a lot of money .
a lot (of...)
修饰域指代可数名词
We need a lot of thing s this week .
many
Many of our products are sold overseas.(修饰名词)
a great many (of...)
He has sent a great many requests for spare part s .
a great number (of...)
he has already visited a great number of different place s in Australia .
a little
有一点(肯定)
修饰或指代不可数名词
There isn't much whisky, but you can have a little .
little
没多点了(否定)
There is little I can do to help him.
a few
有几个(肯定)
修饰域指代可数名词
There aren't many apples, but you can pick a few .
few
不剩几个了(否定)
There were few people in the shop.

parts.text: There isn’t much sugar/aren’t many sweets, but you can have a little/few.
What a lot of sweets Tom’s bought!
I am less lucky. 我还不如他们幸运.
more exciting 更激动 = not less exciting.
这些形容词都用于描述外貌或物品的外观，但它们的重点和适用对象略有不同。根据具体情况，你可以选择合适的形容词来描述人或物的外貌。

headers: handsome 漂亮的，英俊的，制作精良的
beautiful 美丽的，令人愉悦的，完美的
pretty 漂亮的，可爱的，令人怜爱的
good-looking 好看的，标致的，美貌的
rows: He was handsome, upright, and chivalrous. 男子，物品制作精良
She was a very beautiful woman. 强调内在和外在的结合，形容女子，孩童，花草，服饰，等
You look so pretty in that dress! 强调女孩，小孩，外表美丽的对象
My furniture is good-looking. 男女均适用，外貌美丽的对象

headers: reach 到达，达到，适用范围广
arrive 到达，抵达，通常与介词in/at配合使用
arrive in 到达某个地点的里面
arrive at 到达某个地点
rows: When you reach my age, you’ll be able to understand it. Can you get that book down for me please? I can’t reach it.
When I arrived at the station, the train had already gone.
We arrived in New York yesterday.
We arrive at the station in good time.

headers: take place (与 "happen" 同义) 发生，进行，举行
rows: I didn’t take part in their conversation. It was the loudest/oldest car taking part.
What happened? = What took place? All these took place before you were born. The Olympic Games will take place in our country in four years’ time . The next race will take place in a year's time
